headline: Junior Software Engineer
summary: Enthusiastic Computer Engineering graduate from Pulchowk Campus with a strong foundation in full-stack development and software architecture. Proven ability to deliver high-quality code through a professional internship at Nepal's leading fintech firm and several complex academic projects. Committed to continuous learning and solving real-world problems through technology.

experiences.title: Software Engineer Intern
description: Collaborated with the backend team to optimize transaction processing modules for the eSewa ecosystem, improving response times by 15%.
Assisted in the development of RESTful APIs using Java Spring Boot to support new feature rollouts in the mobile banking application.
Participated in daily stand-ups and code reviews, ensuring adherence to internal coding standards and security protocols.
Identified and resolved 20+ bugs within the staging environment, contributing to a stable production release.

experiences.title: Lead Developer - Local Market E-commerce Platform
description: Developed a full-stack e-commerce solution tailored for local Nepalese artisans using React.js and Django Rest Framework.
Implemented a secure payment gateway integration simulation and a real-time inventory management system.
Optimized database queries in PostgreSQL, reducing page load times for product listings by 30%.
Managed the project lifecycle using Git/GitHub and coordinated tasks among a team of three students.

experiences.title: Developer - Facial Recognition Attendance System
description: Built an automated attendance tracking application using Python, OpenCV, and the dlib library.
Achieved 94% accuracy in facial detection and recognition within a controlled classroom environment.
Integrated an automated email reporting system that sends weekly attendance summaries to faculty members.
Utilized SQLite for lightweight local storage of student records and attendance logs.
